items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Allen. Old Man Allen. ... Most of them bands, old Man Allen. All them that couldn't, he'd always get the men that could read

ctx.x: Well, did they have any other brass bands? Oh, yeah. Who were some of the other ones?
Allen. Old Man Allen. Tulane, Amos Riley. Mm-hmm.
Did they have any strictly head brass bands?
